# Elf Destiny trade buildings. Generated by modkit harness/port/gen_trade_goods.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Elven Workshop: needs the Elven Craftsmanship tradition (PM 2026-11-15). Turns wood into Elven Crafts; gems, silver and
# (with Mythril Working) mythril add output.

elven_workshop_1 = {
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	can_construct_potential = {
		culture = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_elf }
		culture = { has_cultural_parameter = unlocks_elven_workshop }
	}
	show_disabled = yes
	cost_gold = premium_building_cost_tier_1
	province_modifier = {
		monthly_artisan_tax = normal_artisan_building_tax_tier_1
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_wood_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_good_gems_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_good_silver_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_wood
		amount = guild_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_elven_crafts_production_add = guild_brewery_output_per_need
				prosperity_growth = guild_prosperity_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_gems
		amount = guild_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_elven_crafts_production_add = guild_brewery_output_per_need
				prosperity_growth = guild_prosperity_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_silver
		amount = guild_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_elven_crafts_production_add = guild_brewery_output_per_need
				prosperity_growth = guild_prosperity_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_mythril
		amount = guild_resource_need
		culture_parameter = unlocks_mythril_working
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_elven_crafts_production_add = guild_brewery_output_per_need
				prosperity_growth = guild_prosperity_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	next_building = elven_workshop_2
	type_icon = "elf_destiny/elven_workshop.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_economical_building_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_general_building_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_regular_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}

# Lembas Bakery: needs the Lembas Baking innovation, found on expeditions (PM 2026-11-15). Turns grain (and honey) into Lembas.

lembas_bakery_1 = {
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	can_construct_potential = {
		culture = { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_elf }
		culture = { has_innovation = innovation_lembas_baking }
	}
	show_disabled = yes
	cost_gold = premium_building_cost_tier_1
	province_modifier = {
		monthly_artisan_tax = normal_artisan_building_tax_tier_1
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_grain_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
		trade_good_honey_sell_price_mult = price_basic_building_1
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_grain
		amount = guild_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_lembas_production_add = guild_brewery_output_per_need
				prosperity_growth = guild_prosperity_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_honey
		amount = guild_resource_need
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_lembas_production_add = guild_brewery_output_per_need
				prosperity_growth = guild_prosperity_per_production_need
			}
		}
	}
	next_building = lembas_bakery_2
	type_icon = "elf_destiny/lembas_bakery.dds"
	ai_value = {
		base = 10
		ai_economical_building_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_general_building_modifier = yes
		ai_income_building_modifier = yes
		ai_regular_new_building_modifier = yes
	}
}

# Mythril Mine: the primary building of a mythril vein (special district). Needs the Mythril Working innovation.

mythril_mine_01 = {
	effect_desc = mines_effect_desc
	construction_time = slow_construction_time
	type_icon = "special_buildings/mines.dds"
	can_construct = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = mythril_mine_needs_mythril_working
			scope:holder.culture = { has_innovation = innovation_mythril_working }
		}
	}
	is_enabled = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = mythril_mine_needs_mythril_working
			scope:holder.culture = { has_innovation = innovation_mythril_working }
		}
	}
	show_disabled = yes
	cost_gold = expensive_building_tier_3_cost
	province_modifier = {
		monthly_mining_tax = silver_mine_generic_building_tax_tier_1
		trade_good_mythril_production_add = 40
	}
	next_building = mythril_mine_02
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_lembas
		amount = special_building_need_amount
		can_be_filled_multiple_times = 5
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				trade_good_mythril_production_mult = 0.05
			}
		}
	}
	ai_value = {
		base = 100
		directive_to_build_economy_modifier = yes
		ai_special_district_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}
	flag = travel_point_of_interest_economic
}
